description.value: Captain's Oven Pizza is a BC-grown Neapolitan-style pizza chain founded by two siblings who trained in Naples and Istanbul before bringing their craft to North Vancouver. Pizzas are hand-stretched daily and baked in under two minutes in a custom 3-ton stone-brick oven imported from Tuscany, producing a light, charred crust true to the Neapolitan tradition. The North Vancouver location is one of five across the Lower Mainland, with a broad menu of meat, vegetarian, vegan, and gluten-free options alongside salads, desserts, and catering.
